description: This source file defines the IncludeEmployee class, which extends the FilterField class and is part of the filtering mechanism for HR reports within the OrangeHRM system. The class adds conditions to a query builder to include or exclude employees based on their termination record status.

classes.name: IncludeEmployee
classes.description: A filter field class used to include or exclude employees based on their termination record in HR reports.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds conditions to the query builder to filter employees based on termination record presence, depending on the operator used.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns aliases of entities involved in the filter, currently only 'employee'.
